Subject: Re: sudden latency spike - hosted API p95/p99 regression (impacting checkout)

Triage notes (initial):
- I pulled the traces Samantha attached and correlated with our routing logs. At ~08:50 PST we pushed a routing policy change that unintentionally expanded the eu-fallback shard to include traffic with an empty region tag. A small percentage of us-west requests matched the new predicate and were routed to eu-central capacity.
- RTT rise is consistent with cross-region hop (~900-1600ms extra RTT). Error rate increased when kv-cache priming failed across replica boundaries. Throughput drop aligns with increased per-request latency and some connection timeouts.

Immediate remediation I recommend:
1) Roll back the routing policy to the previous (pre-08:50) version — this should restore normal pathing for us-west traffic.
2) Apply a temporary pinning rule for Acme (customer_id: acme-123) to force us-west affinity until we validate.

I can roll back now and monitor, but need approval from ops (Hannah) to push the policy rollback to prod. Attaching the small diff of the routing policy change for review.
[Attachment: routing_policy_diff.txt (text)]

— Jonas (on-call infra)

Summary:

- Impact: Elevated p95/p99 for hosted API requests (observed 09:12–10:40 PST on 2026-11-02). Primary cause: faulty routing policy change at ~08:50 that allowed empty-region traffic to fall back to eu-central. Secondary: KV cache cold-starts and keep-alive mismatches increased p95 after rollback.
- Actions taken: rollback of policy at 09:50 PST on 11/02; temporary customer pin applied; additional tuning to KV priming and keep-alive parameters performed by infra.
- Current state: customer reports errors reduced to baseline; p95 improved but some paths still ~20–30% above historical baseline. Customer is asking for an executive summary and one-time credit; procurement is looping in Oliver Chen.

Requests:
1) Approve a one-time service credit up to 10% of last month’s bill for Acme while we complete RCA and postmortem.
2) Approve a customer-facing postmortem and offer a 30-minute exec call with our Ben C-suite-facing CS lead.
3) Ops: provide a remediation plan and timeline (RCA + tests to ensure routing predicates include explicit region non-empty checks). Jonas / Sean, can you provide a short remediation ETA by tomorrow EOD?

I've started a draft postmortem and attached for review (postmortem-draft.md). Happy to take edits and push to the customer once we have the technical confirmation and credit approved. This is elevated; Samantha indicated exec attention on their side.
